findings.title: Invalid CSS property `-ms-align-items` emitted by align-items mixin
findings.body: The mixin emits `-ms-align-items: $alignment;`, which is not a valid CSS property. The IE10 vendor prefix for align-items is `-ms-flex-align` (already included on the preceding line). Sass will compile this and ship it to the browser, where it is parsed as an unknown declaration and ignored. It also fails strict CSS validation and can produce warnings in tooling. The line should be removed.

findings.title: `order: 2` applied to a non-flex child has no effect
findings.body: `@include order(2)` is added to `.extra-info-wrapper`, but its parent `.title-wrapper` is styled in this same file as `float: left; width: 90%;` and is not a flex container. The `order` property only affects flex/grid items, so this declaration is dead CSS in the rendered output. If the intent was to reorder `.extra-info-wrapper` relative to the title, the author likely also needs `@include flexbox()` on `.title-wrapper` (and an explicit order for the other children). Otherwise the line should be removed because it implies a layout change that will not happen.
